title: Caraga cops log peaceful Undas; cemetery crowd tops 350,000

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day across Caraga (Region 13) was generally peaceful and orderly, with over 350,000 people visiting cemeteries and memorial parks, the Police Regional Office -13 (PRO-13) said Tuesday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, PRO-13 director, said no untoward or major peace and order incidents were recorded during the four-day holiday monitoring period. “The observance was generally peaceful, with no significant incidents recorded. This success is attributed to our early preparations, coordinated deployment, and strict security operations with partner agencies,” Suguilon said. READ: DA seeks P6.2-M cloud seeding funds […]...
